payload.name: Heuristic Vetoing
payload.fact: Heuristic information can be strong enough to override empirical sensory evidence during real-world decision making.
payload.boundary: Recognition of camouflaged objects by expert viewers.

provenance.title: Heuristic Vetoing: Top-Down Influences of the Anchoring-and-Adjustment Heuristic Can Override the Bottom-Up Information in Visual Images
provenance.quote_or_locus: Together, these results demonstrate a novel aspect of the interaction between heuristics and sensory information during real-world decision making, where the former can be strong enough to veto the latter
